sovereign_country.strategic_role: 西欧核心消费市场、高客单价品牌合规与本土清关

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Construction of Thermal Multi-Stage Flash and Membrane Desalination

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: France (Metropolitan France - ordinary-law seat for SAS incorporation)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law - codified unitary system governed by the Code civil, Code de commerce and Code monétaire et financier, with binding jurisprudence of the Cour de cassation and Conseil d'État
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: France-China Bilateral Investment Treaty (signed 30 May 1984, in force 18 March 1985)
France-China Double Taxation Avoidance Agreement (signed 30 November 1984, as amended by the Protocol of 26 November 2013, effective 1 January 2015)
EU-China Comprehensive Agreement on Investment (signed 30 December 2020, pending ratification - not yet in force, monitored for entry into force)
Energy Charter Treaty (France is a Contracting Party; EU-coordinated withdrawal announced in 2024 but treaty remains applicable pending formal denunciation)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Articles L. 561-1 to L. 561-57, L. 561-45 to L. 561-50 and R. 561-1 to R. 561-59 of the Code monétaire et financier (CMF), as amended by Law No. 2016-1691 of 9 December 2016 (Sapin II) and Ordonnance No. 2020-115 of 12 February 2020; Décret No. 2014-1004 of 4 September 2014 on the beneficial-owner declaration (déclaration de bénéficiaires effectifs); Décret No. 2016-1539 of 15 November 2016; Articles R. 123-53, R. 123-54 and R. 123-77 of the Code de commerce; INPI Guichet Unique procedure under Décret No. 2021-1932 of 30 December 2021; Tracfin AML/CFT guidelines (Lignes directrices 2023).
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access - registers are available to competent supervisory authorities, Tracfin, the tax administration and obliged entities performing KYC; the general public no longer has unconditional access following CJEU judgments C-37/20 and C-601/20 of 22 November 2022, but any natural or legal person may request access on proof of a legitimate interest (Article L. 561-46-2 CMF)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Business licence and Articles of Association (certificat d'immatriculation / statuts) of the non-resident shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) and competent Chinese notary office (公证处), People's Republic of China
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Convention of 5 October 1961, in force for the PRC since 7 November 2023) applied by the Chinese Ministry of Foreign Affairs or an authorised provincial foreign-affairs office; consular legalization by the French Consulate only for legacy documents predating the apostille regime

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarised Power of Attorney (mandat) of the foreign parent authorising the SAS founder / authorised representative in France
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Chinese notary office (公证处) with apostille certificate by the Chinese Ministry of Foreign Affairs
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (China-France chain); accepted by the French bank, notary and company registry without further consular form

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified French translation of the shareholder corporate documents (traduction assermentée)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Sworn translator registered with a French Cour d'appel (expert judiciaire)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Not subject to apostille; the sworn translator's certification is accepted under French evidentiary rules with the apostilled source documents attached

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of non-opposition to the company name and declaration of beneficial owners (certificat de non-opposition au nom and déclaration des bénéficiaires effectifs)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Greffe du tribunal de commerce (Court Registry) and Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle (INPI) via formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Domestic public instrument; no notarization or legalization required

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank certificate of blocked funds representing the share capital subscription (attestation de blocage de fonds) for the SAS en formation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: EEA credit institution (e.g., BNP Paribas, Société Générale, HSBC Continental Europe) or licensed escrow agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Domestic banking instrument accepted upon original presentation; no legalization required for an EEA-established bank

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory dual-pillar screening at formation: (i) automated PEP screening of all UBOs, directors and authorised signatories against the French Treasury (DG Trésor) sanctions list, the EU consolidated financial sanctions list, the UN Security Council consolidated list and, for USD-denominated wires, the OFAC SDN list; (ii) adverse-media and ownership-chain verification under the risk-based obligations of Articles L. 561-10-2 and L. 561-11 CMF. For the ISIC 4322 desalination EPC scope with a non-resident shareholder, the French bank completes a KYC questionnaire (questionnaire de conformité), an FIBEN check and a risk scorecard; 'Low_Risk_Standard' treatment applies only where the parent is publicly listed or state-controlled, while all other structures attract enhanced due diligence under Article L. 561-13 CMF.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Guichet unique des formalités des entreprises - formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr (operated by the INPI on behalf of the French State); name availability verification via the Registre National du Commerce et des Sociétés (RNCS) through Infogreffe (www.infogreffe.fr) and the INPI trademark database (data.inpi.fr)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Under the Toubon Law (Law No. 94-665 of 4 August 1994, Articles 2 and 5) and Article 1 of Décret No. 84-406, the corporate name must be capable of being stated and read in French; any Chinese-language denomination must be transliterated into Latin characters (pinyin) for inscription in the RCS, legal publications and invoicing; if the name contains Chinese characters, a French transliteration is mandatory and a French descriptive subtitle (e.g., 'Dessalement d'eau de mer - EPC') is recommended for the JAL publication
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Banque / bank (Article L. 511-1 CMF - prior credit-institution licence required)
Crédit / credit (same licensing regime under the CMF)
Assurance / insurance (prior authorisation by the ACPR required)
Mutuelle / mutualité (prior approval by the mutualité supervisory authorities)
France / République / État / Gouvernement / Ministère / National (protected official denominations - prior ministerial authorisation and high refusal risk)
Europe / Union européenne (prior authorisation where the term implies EU institutional sponsorship)
Chambre de commerce / Barreau / Ordre / Notaire / Avocat (regulated professional titles creating confusion with regulated bodies)
Any term contrary to public order or decency prohibited under Article 9 of Décret No. 84-406
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the greffe or the INPI guichet unique issues a reasoned refusal (rejet). The applicant may file a gracieux administrative appeal within 15 days addressed to the Directeur régional of the INPI or to the greffe of the Tribunal de commerce; if the refusal is maintained, the founder may seize the Tribunal judiciaire in référé under Article R. 123-91 of the Code de commerce requesting registration under the refused name or an alternative name. Where the refusal is grounded in a trademark conflict, parallel opposition proceedings before the INPI may be lodged within the statutory opposition windows. Filing a fresh alternative name at the guichet unique is immediately possible without prejudice to the appeal.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible in restricted form. A French SAS may elect its seat at the premises of an approved domiciliation company (société de domiciliation agréée) for a maximum of five years, renewable, under Décret No. 2016-1348; home domiciliation of the manager is also available under Article L. 123-11-1 of the Code de commerce. For the ISIC 4322 desalination EPC contractor, a virtual office is acceptable at incorporation only as a short-term domicile; the project-financing escrow bank, the customs import chain and the travaux public client will require a physical operating address - a site office near the works and a permanent administrative office in France are expected within 6 to 12 months.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 15% to 20% within the first 12 months, rising to 30% to 40% over three years where the SAS declares no permanent staff, requests VAT refunds, or reports administrative expenses inconsistent with turnover; inspections are typically unannounced and conducted by the inspection du travail, URSSAF and the tax administration's vérification de comptabilité on a risk-score trigger.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Greffe du tribunal de commerce (via Infogreffe)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registry tariff (tarif des greffiers) of approximately EUR 38 per search and certificate

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Publication of the statutory incorporation notice in a legal announcement gazette (JAL) of the registered office department
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Accredited legal announcement journal (Journal d'annonces légales)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Regulated advertising tariff per number of lines under the arrêté of 10 June 2015; market range EUR 120 to EUR 350

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Preparation and digital filing of the UBO declaration (déclaration des bénéficiaires effectifs) with the appendices
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: INPI Guichet Unique (filing fee EUR 0) and French avocat
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark fixed fee for the KYC/AML UBO report and certificate assembly

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified French translation of the Chinese shareholder corporate documents (statuts, business licence, PoA, resolutions)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Sworn translator (traducteur expert près la cour d'appel)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market tariff of EUR 80 to EUR 150 per certified page, invoiced per page count

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille of the notarised Chinese parent corporate bundle (notarization plus apostille for three to four documents)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Chinese notary office (公证处) and Chinese Ministry of Foreign Affairs / provincial apostille office (外事办公室)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Chinese administrative fee schedule: notarization RMB 200 to 500 per document; apostille RMB 50 to 100 per document

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Domiciliation of the registered office with an approved domiciliation company (year one)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Approved French domiciliation company (société de domiciliation agréée)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark annual fee of EUR 600 to 1,200 including handling of legal notifications

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Drafting of the SAS statutes (articles of association) with UBO annex, governance terms and capital statement
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark SAS formation package of EUR 2,000 to 4,500 including registration assistance

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Corporate bank account opening and EDD/KYC compliance screening for the non-resident parent
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: French commercial bank (BNP Paribas, Société Générale, HSBC Continental Europe)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Bank official fee schedule applicable to corporate account origination; one-time fee of EUR 0 to 300

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Mandatory registration duties and registry fees at the Guichet Unique (droit fixe, taxe de greffe, RNCS fee)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: INPI and Greffe du tribunal de commerce
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory fee schedule: EUR 38 droit fixe, EUR 28 frais de greffe for the M0 filing and EUR 13 RNCS tax (approximate official amounts)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code, Articles L.227-1 to L.227-20 and R.227-1 et seq. governing sociétés par actions simplifiées; Articles L.123-1 et seq. and R.123-1 et seq. governing registration and the Register National des Entreprises; Article L.561-46 governing beneficial-owner reporting.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Institut national de la propriété industrielle (INPI), Guichet unique des formalités des entreprises, with registration in the Registre National des Entreprises (RNE) and allocation through the competent commercial court registry.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Electronic declaration of incorporation of a société par actions simplifiée through the Guichet unique, supported by signed articles of association, beneficial-owner declaration, statutory auditor statement where applicable, and legal-notice publication certificate.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital applies; capital may be EUR 1 or more. At least 50% of cash contributions must be paid at incorporation, with the balance payable within five years. Funds must be deposited with a bank, notary, or Caisse des Dépôts, and the deposit certificate must support incorporation. Contributions in kind must be fully contributed and generally require a commissaire aux apports unless the statutory exemption conditions are satisfied. The stated USD amount is an approximate conversion of the standard EUR 37.45 registration charge and excludes legal-publication, beneficial-owner, translation, and professional-service costs.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: The President records that the Company has been duly incorporated as a société par actions simplifiée under French law. It is resolved that: (1) the shareholders’ subscriptions and payments for the issued shares are approved and recorded; (2) the registered office at the address stated in the articles of association is adopted; (3) [Name] is appointed President for an indefinite term, subject to the articles; (4) [Name] is appointed Director-General, if applicable, with the authority specified in the articles; and (5) the President is authorized to complete all registry, tax, beneficial-owner, banking, licensing, and publication formalities.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Approve corporate structure and execute articles
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Company shareholders, founders, and the Guichet unique des formalités des entreprises operated by INPI
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Select the corporate name, registered office, purpose, capital, share rights, transfer restrictions, President, and any Director-General. Execute the articles electronically or in wet ink. Obtain a registered-office title, domiciliation contract, or landlord consent. Foreign corporate documents must be legalized or apostilled where required and accompanied by French sworn translations. Notarization is not generally required for SAS articles, but notarized powers of attorney may be used for representatives.
required_dossiers: Shareholder identification and, for corporate shareholders, current registry extracts and powers of attorney
French sworn translations and apostilles or legalizations for foreign documents
Description and valuation documents for contributions in kind, where applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct defective clauses, signatures, translations, powers of attorney, or address evidence before submission. Obtain a replacement corporate-name certificate or amend the articles if the registry identifies a naming conflict.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Deposit share capital and obtain the certificate of deposit
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: French credit institution, notary, or Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a formation account, provide the draft articles and shareholder identification, transfer the subscribed cash capital, and obtain the certificate of deposit. The certificate must identify the company under formation, deposited amount, depositors, and date. After registration, provide the final Kbis or RNE registration evidence to release the funds into the operating account.
required_dossiers: Draft or signed articles of association
Power of attorney for the filing representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to bank know-your-customer requests, correct discrepancies in shareholder or source-of-funds information, and obtain a corrected deposit certificate before filing. If a bank refuses the account, approach another eligible institution or a notary.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publish the legal notice of incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Authorized legal-notice publication service in the department of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the mandatory avis de constitution containing the company name, legal form, capital, registered office, purpose, duration, President, and registration details required by the applicable notice template. Pay the regulated publication charge and retain the publication certificate for the Guichet unique filing.
required_dossiers: Final signed articles or approved incorporation data
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Request correction or republication if mandatory information is omitted or inaccurate. Upload the corrected publication certificate and preserve both versions for the corporate file.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI Guichet unique des formalités des entreprises and the competent commercial court registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Create the electronic formation filing, select société par actions simplifiée, upload the articles, capital-deposit certificate, publication certificate, registered-office evidence, officer declarations, identity documents, and beneficial-owner filing. Sign using the required electronic authentication, pay the filing charges, and monitor the portal for queries. The registry then issues the SIREN, SIRET, APE code, and Kbis or equivalent registration evidence.
required_dossiers: Identity documents and non-conviction declarations for officers
Foreign-document legalizations, apostilles, and sworn translations
Power of attorney, if filed by an agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Answer the registry query through the portal within the stated deadline, upload corrected or additional documents, and pay any supplementary charge. If rejected, cure the stated defect and resubmit; challenge an unlawful refusal before the competent court where appropriate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Complete post-registration governance and tax registrations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI RNE, Service des impôts des entreprises, URSSAF, and the company’s bank
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Download and archive the Kbis or RNE extract, confirm SIREN/SIRET and VAT treatment, activate the operating bank account, maintain the share register and register of shareholder movements, and adopt the first board or shareholder resolutions. Register as an employer before hiring, arrange mandatory insurance, and assess statutory-auditor requirements under French thresholds and control-group rules.
required_dossiers: Share register and shareholder movement register
Employment and payroll registrations, if applicable
Professional liability and décennale insurance evidence, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct tax or social-security registration data through the relevant portal, submit missing declarations, and request written confirmation of the corrected status. Replace defective corporate registers or resolutions and document ratification by the competent corporate body.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: The competent Préfet of the project department, acting through the Direction régionale de l'environnement, de l'aménagement et du logement (DREAL), or through the Direction régionale et interdépartementale de l'environnement, de l'aménagement et des transports (DRIEAT) in the Île-de-France region. The local mairie and, where relevant, maritime authorities also participate.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Project-specific autorisation environnementale under French Environmental Code Articles L.181-1 et seq., potentially combining an Installation Classée pour la Protection de l'Environnement (ICPE) authorization or registration and an authorization under the water-law regime (IOTA) for seawater intake, brine discharge, marine works, or water abstraction. A building permit and separate construction authorizations may also be required.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: French environmental authority, generally the competent Mission régionale d'autorité environnementale (MRAe), with technical processing by the competent DREAL or DRIEAT under the authority of the Ministry responsible for ecological transition.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Project-specific screening under Environmental Code Article R.122-2. A full environmental-impact assessment may be required for the plant, intake and outfall structures, marine works, energy systems, or associated pipelines; otherwise a reasoned exemption or case-by-case screening decision may apply. An autorisation environnementale dossier is normally required where IOTA or ICPE thresholds are triggered.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: The permit must specify site-specific limits for brine salinity, temperature, flow, chemicals, suspended solids, pH, and receiving-water impacts. Compliance must address the Water Framework Directive, Marine Strategy Framework Directive, French water-law requirements, applicable ICPE ministerial orders, hazardous-substance controls, VOC and combustion-emission limits where relevant, and waste-management obligations. There is no single nationwide desalination discharge limit applicable to every project; baseline studies, mixing-zone analysis, monitoring, and permit conditions determine the enforceable thresholds.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Obtain the applicable building permit and safety approvals from the mairie, consult the Service départemental d'incendie et de secours (SDIS) for fire strategy, provide fire detection, suppression, emergency access, hazardous-material storage, and evacuation measures, and complete structural and equipment conformity inspections. Industrial electrical, pressure-equipment, lifting-equipment, and machinery inspections must be performed by competent bodies where required. Occupational compliance requires a risk assessment document (document unique d'évaluation des risques), occupational-health arrangements, worker training, and labor-law compliance; a separate generic workplace operating clearance is not generally required.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) via impots.gouv.fr portal
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: French-registered entities obtain SIREN/SIRET through Chambre de Commerce et d'Industrie; foreign-owned entities register for VAT ID (FR + SIREN) with DGFiP upon turnover threshold or fixed establishment
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box elections available; limited hybrid mismatch relief under EU ATAD directives

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory facturation électronique with ANF-compliant XML/JSON formats; real-time fiscal clearance and digital stamping via authorized platforms

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% VAT on goods exported outside EU and qualifying offshore services; requires proof of export and non-EU destination
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading or equivalent transport document
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: 40% penalty on erroneously claimed zero-rated VAT plus interest; full clawback and potential criminal prosecution for fraudulent claims

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France (Bank of France), with the French Prudential Supervision and Resolution Authority (ACPR) as the integrated banking licensing, AML/CFT and conduct supervisor; the Ministry of Economy and Finance retains sovereignty over financial sanctions, strategic foreign-investment screening and balance-of-payments statistical rules.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France is a euro-area Member State and applies full currency convertibility under the EU free-movement-of-capital framework (Articles 63-65 TFEU and Articles L.151-1 et seq. of the French Monetary and Financial Code). There are no exchange-control permits, no forced conversion requirements, and no restrictions on holding EUR or foreign currency balances in licensed bank accounts. Current-account and capital-account transactions are unrestricted, subject only to general AML/KYC, sanctions, tax declaration and statistical reporting obligations. Profit remittance from the French SAS is lawful once corporate formalities are completed; dividends may be paid in EUR or foreign currency without FX approval, but are subject to French withholding tax unless reduced by treaty or the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive, and to beneficial-ownership, substance and anti-abuse verification.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No export-proceeds surrender or mandatory conversion rules exist in French or EU law. There is no statutory repatriation timeline, no minimum conversion ratio and no obligation to surrender foreign currency earned from desalination EPC contracts. Export receipts may be retained in USD/EUR operating accounts or applied directly to foreign-currency trade payables. The only obligations are (i) correct recording of each transaction in the Banque de France balance-of-payments statistics through the resident bank using the applicable purpose code, and (ii) full compliance with EU sanctions, customs and foreign-asset reporting rules. No central-bank licence is required for holding export proceeds.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Crédit Agricole Corporate and Investment Bank

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium-to-Low as a primary treasury rail but acceptable as a secondary payment-companion. ACPR-regulated electronic money institutions (EMIs) such as Qonto, Shine, Treezor or other BaaS providers can offer French IBANs, SEPA/SEPA Instant clearing, multicurrency virtual accounts and corporate cards; however, they cannot grant credit, issue commercial letters of credit, hold project-finance escrow as a licensed credit institution, or provide MiFID II FX derivative execution without a separate investment-services licence. Offshore digital EMIs with no French establishment or EU passport have low viability because they cannot issue French IBANs, create ACPR-authorisation risk if used as a main account, and are frequently debanked under enhanced KYC. Recommended structure: use an ACPR-regulated fintech for operational expenses and supplier convenience payments, while placing project capital escrow, trade disbursements and hedging with tier-1 credit institutions.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: French AML/CFT law does not explicitly require physical attendance by directors; risk-based remote onboarding is permitted where digital identity verification and a qualified electronic signature are used. In practice, tier-1 French banks will normally require at least one physical or video-verified interview with each signatory, plus certified copies of constitutional documents, a UBO register filing, apostilles or notarisation for foreign entities, and the physical presence of a French registered office or a designated local representative. Remote onboarding is feasible for a straightforward SAS with transparent shareholders, but a fully remote opening without any French contact is unlikely. Expected timeline for non-resident corporate onboarding is four to eight weeks; for project-financing escrow with complex EPC disbursement schedules, the bank may require a face-to-face escalation meeting.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opaque beneficial-ownership chain or non-resident holding company incorporated in a low-transparency jurisdiction
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete French UBO declaration registered at the Greffe; certificate of incorporation and articles of association in authenticated translation; apostilled ownership chart naming every natural-person shareholder with 25% or more; tax-residence certificates of all intermediate entities; audited financial statements and a written narrative explaining the commercial purpose of each holding layer.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Desalination project counterparties located in high-risk or sanctions-sensitive regions, including advance payments from those jurisdictions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Original signed EPC contract and full commercial invoices; corporate registers and KYC documentation of project owners and end-buyers; host-country government approvals or central-bank permits; end-user and non-proliferation certificates; UN/EU sanctions screening results with same-name explanations; funds-origin evidence and a description of the full payment chain.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Large and rapid capital injections inconsistent with the company's stated share capital and project stage
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Shareholder resolution approving the capital increase; capital deposit attestation issued by the receiving bank; source-of-wealth and source-of-funds statements; shareholder bank statements evidencing provenance of funds; project-finance facility agreement or term sheet; board-approved treasury forecast showing allocation of injected funds to EPC costs and escrow requirements.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Nominee directors, absence of local substance, or reliance on a managed-service provider for the French SAS
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Directors' declaration confirming real executive responsibilities; CV and business track record; minutes of board and shareholder meetings; French registered-office lease and utility bills; substance documentation for France such as payroll records, project-management location, and decision-making minutes; tax-residence certificates of all directors and beneficial owners.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Disbursement instructions to intermediary payees not named in the EPC contract or to unrelated shell companies
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Escrow/segregation agreement and approved payee schedule; executed supplier and subcontractor agreements; bank confirmation of payment purpose codes; invoices, delivery and acceptance certificates; withholding and tax clearance documentation; a written commercial rationale for each intermediary beneficiary and its connection to the desalination project.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Capital contributions must be wired from the shareholder's own bank account to the French SAS account in the exact corporate name. Use a SWIFT MT103 and include in field 70 the remittance text 'APPORT EN CAPITAL / [SAS name] / [shareholder name] / [date of capital increase resolution]'. The receiving bank will require the capital-increase attestation or 'attestation de dépôt des fonds' before permitting operational use. For non-EU shareholders, no prior FX approval is required, but the resident bank will report the transaction to Banque de France for balance-of-payments statistics using the applicable direct-investment purpose code. Where the capital increase or share-transfer gives a non-EU shareholder voting rights of 25% or more in an entity owning sensitive water infrastructure, prior French strategic-sector FDI screening approval may be required under Articles L.151-1 et seq.; in such cases the subscription cannot close until approval or the legal waiting period has elapsed. Project-financing escrow inflows from lenders or clients should be tagged with the underlying project name, facility agreement and disbursement conditions.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: EU/EEA supplier and subcontractor payments should be cleared through SEPA Credit Transfer, including SEPA Instant where required for urgent milestone payments. Non-SEPA and foreign-currency payments should be routed by SWIFT MT103 for customer credits, with MT202 used only for interbank treasury repositioning between the SAS's own accounts. Large equipment purchases for the desalination plant should be supported by irrevocable at-sight or usance commercial letters of credit opened by the French bank in favour of manufacturers, with full transport, insurance and acceptance documentation. Escrowed client funds must be released only against signed milestone certificates, approved drawdown requests and completion reports. All outbound payments must be screened against EU/UN sanctions, must carry an accurate purpose code, and must be supported by underlying contracts, invoices and customs/import documentation in the bank's file.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright deliverable EUR/USD FX forwards executed with ACPR-licensed credit institutions under MiFID II and EMIR
FX swaps for simultaneous spot and forward conversion of EUR to USD or USD to EUR to cover short-term EPC liquidity mismatches
Cross-currency interest-rate swaps aligning USD-denominated project-finance debt service with EUR treasury flows
Non-deliverable forwards for currencies where local convertibility or deliverability is restricted, provided the counterparty is authorised and the hedge underlying exposure is fully documented

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Approval of annual accounts and allocation of profit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Shareholders or shareholders' collective decision of the SAS
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months after the end of each financial year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to approve accounts may result in court proceedings, management liability, and penalties for related filing failures; no automatic administrative strike-off deadline applies.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Filing of annual accounts and required management documents
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Commercial Court Registry through the French one-stop business portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month after approval, or within two months after approval when filed electronically
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing may trigger a court injunction, a civil fine generally up to EUR 1,500 and up to EUR 3,000 for repeat non-compliance, and possible ex officio deregistration after formal notice; no uniform automatic strike-off period is prescribed.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: French tax administration (Direction générale des finances publiques)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Electronically by the second business day after 1 May for a 31 December year-end; generally within three months after financial year-end for other closing dates
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing may incur a 10% surcharge, increased surcharges for continued delay, late-payment interest, tax assessment procedures, and potential administrative enforcement; no corporate-register strike-off is triggered solely by this filing default.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: French Commercial Court Registry and French one-stop business portal, only where a filing or amendment is required
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No standalone annual confirmation filing; report changes to beneficial ownership or registered particulars without undue delay and generally within 30 days of the relevant change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to declare or update beneficial-owner information may result in formal notice, fines, director liability, and restrictions or removal from the register; no annual filing-based strike-off timetable applies.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual payroll and social-security declarations, where employees are engaged
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: French social-security authorities through the DSN system
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Generally by the fifth or fifteenth day of the following month, depending on employer headcount and payroll status
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late or inaccurate DSN submissions may trigger per-employee penalties, late-payment surcharges, interest, audits, and recovery proceedings; no corporate-register strike-off is automatically imposed.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A statutory auditor is generally mandatory for an SAS exceeding at least two of the following thresholds for two consecutive financial years: EUR 5 million total balance sheet, EUR 10 million net turnover, or 50 average employees. Additional mandatory audit rules apply to parent companies and significant subsidiaries in groups, and may arise from specific regulated activities or contractual requirements.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Individual statutory accounts generally use French GAAP under the Accounting Standards Authority (Autorité des normes comptables). IFRS may be used for qualifying consolidated accounts but is not the default framework for individual SAS accounts.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: France does not require a standalone annual beneficial-owner confirmation. The SAS should perform an annual review of ownership, control, directors, registered office, and business particulars and file any required changes promptly, generally within 30 days. Transfers of shares or changes in control must be reflected in the share-transfer records, register of shareholders, and beneficial-owner filing where applicable.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of shareholders or share-transfer register
Annual accounts approval and allocation-of-profit records
Beneficial-owner documentation and supporting control analysis

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: 600-1,800 per year for a standard registered-office and corporate-secretarial service; higher for operational premises, mail handling, or enhanced compliance support
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: 4,000-15,000 per year for a small SAS; materially higher for a construction or desalination EPC business with project-finance, group-reporting, consolidation, or complex revenue-recognition requirements

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Reduced rate of 15% on first €42,500 of taxable profit for small companies (turnover < €10M); research tax credit (CIR) up to 30% of eligible R&D expenses; innovation tax credit (CII) for SMEs.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 2065 (annual corporate income tax return) and accompanying schedules (2065-SD, 2058-SD, etc.) filed electronically via EFI (Electronic Filing for Tax) on impots.gouv.fr
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: For fiscal year ending 31 December, the deadline is the second business day after 1 May of the following year; for other fiscal year-ends, the deadline is within 3 months of the year-end.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income (or loss) after adjustments for non-deductible expenses and tax credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident entities must report French-source income only; allocate expenses proportionally if applicable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax losses carried forward from prior years, subject to the €1,000,000 plus 50% of excess limitation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident entities may carry forward losses only if they have a permanent establishment in France.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax credits (e.g., CIR, CII, foreign tax credits) applied against the tax liability.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-residents must attach supporting documentation for any foreign tax credit claimed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final taxable base after adjustments; used to compute the corporate income tax at 25% (or 15% for eligible small profits).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Ensure all French-source income is correctly reported; non-residents without a PE are subject to withholding tax instead of filing Form 2065.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty: 5% of the tax due, increased by 0.5% per month of delay, capped at 10% of the tax due; additional 10% penalty for failure to file after a formal notice; interest on late payment at 0.20% per month.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To claim treaty-reduced dividend withholding tax, the non-resident shareholder must provide a valid Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) from their home jurisdiction and complete Form 5000 (or 5001 for individuals) to the French tax authority. The payer must retain the certificate and apply the treaty rate at source. For EU/EEA shareholders, the Parent-Subsidiary Directive may reduce the rate to 0% if the shareholding is at least 10% and held for 2 years.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: statutory rate 33.33%; treaty rates typically 0% or 10% (e.g., US-France DTA: 0% for copyright, 10% for industrial royalties). Interest: statutory rate 30%; treaty rates typically 0% or 10% (e.g., US-France DTA: 0% for arm's length interest).

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: €400,000,000 (turnover or balance sheet total) for the entity or the group to which it belongs; below this threshold, simplified documentation may suffice.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: France applies substance-over-form principles and anti-abuse rules (e.g., Article 155-A of the French Tax Code) to prevent artificial arrangements. While no specific Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) exist, the entity must demonstrate real economic activity (e.g., premises, employees, decision-making) to maintain tax residency and treaty benefits.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate understatement of taxable income, false accounting, or concealment of French-source revenue (e.g., failing to report desalination project profits).
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal fine up to €500,000 and imprisonment up to 5 years (Article 1741 of the French Tax Code); civil penalties up to 80% of the evaded tax plus interest.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be held personally liable for unpaid corporate taxes if they participated in or knowingly allowed the evasion; travel bans and asset freezes may be imposed; criminal conviction can lead to imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating as a shell entity with no real economic substance (e.g., no employees, no physical presence, no actual business activity) to claim treaty benefits or avoid French taxation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Denial of treaty benefits, recharacterization of transactions, and imposition of 40% penalty for abuse of law (Article 64 of the French Tax Procedure Code); potential criminal charges for fraud.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be jointly liable for the company's tax debts if they are found to have created or used the shell structure; personal fines up to €75,000 and imprisonment up to 5 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to implement AML controls (e.g., customer due diligence, transaction monitoring) in the context of large cross-border project payments, or knowingly facilitating money laundering through the desalination project financing.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative fines up to €5 million or 5% of turnover (Monetary and Financial Code); criminal penalties up to 5 years imprisonment and €375,000 fine for money laundering (Article 324-1 of the Criminal Code).
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors can be held criminally liable for AML breaches if they knowingly participated or failed to prevent; personal fines, imprisonment, and prohibition from managing a company for up to 10 years.
